title: Node Config
egressDescOutbound: Outbound: Requests are forwarded by Centag to the upstream LLM, authenticated with the backend API Key (clients only need to connect to Centag).
egressDescMatchModel: Match Model: Matches the model name from the client request against enabled backends; if matched, uses that backend; otherwise falls back to the default backend/model below.
egressDescFixed: Fixed Outbound: No model matching; always uses the selected backend/model below (or system default).
fixedEgressHelp: Used as the sole egress when Fixed Outbound is selected.
matchModelFallbackHelp: When Match Model has no hit, falls back to the default backend/model here.
appendPositionMergeLast: Append into the same system message
appendPositionHelp: “User instructions” = client's system text; “gateway text” = what you enter below.
appendPositionExampleTitle: Example (user: “You are a coding assistant”, gateway: “Answer in Chinese”)
appendPositionExampleAfter:
Model receives 2 system messages:
1. You are a coding assistant
2. Answer in Chinese
appendPositionExampleBefore:
Model receives 2 system messages:
1. Answer in Chinese
2. You are a coding assistant
appendPositionExampleMerge:
Model receives 1 system message:
You are a coding assistant
Answer in Chinese
(both texts concatenated with a newline)
systemPromptHelp: Applied per strategy: passthrough keeps client system; append keeps it and adds this text; replace overwrites with this text.
generatorStrategyHelp: Legacy default is replace when system prompt is set; choose passthrough to keep the client system message.
promptPlaceholderGenerator: Optional. Set the model's role or behavior, e.g.: You are a professional technical assistant...
promptPlaceholderTransparentForward: Used after enabling injection. Gateway personality replaces the client system message...
promptPlaceholderAggregator: Optional. Input instructions for how the LLM should aggregate multiple upstream outputs...
promptPlaceholderDefault: Write your Prompt here. Click variable names below to insert quickly.
generatorPromptHelp: A non-empty system prompt will override the client system message.
aggregatorPromptHelp: Optional. Leave empty to use the default summary prompt. Available: {{.combined_content}}
tokenUsageAlert: Requires upstream outbound/generator node; do not convert the sole generator into a usage node.
injectConditionPlaceholder: Leave empty to always inject; supports template variables
builtinVarQuestionDesc: The original question sent by the user, automatically passed through the engine, usable by any node
builtinVarAnswerDesc: Content from the upstream generator node, i.e. the answer to be reviewed
builtinVarTimestampDesc: Current execution time, RFC3339 format, e.g. 2026-04-24T15:30:00+08:00
builtinVarCriteriaDesc: Review criteria list (array), from node config custom_config.criteria, iterate with {{range .criteria}}-{{.}} {{end}}
builtinVarInputDesc: Content from the upstream node (text to process), typically the generator's answer
builtinVarTargetLangDesc: Target language, only effective when operation=translate, from node custom_config.target_lang
builtinVarMetadataDesc: Complete metadata object from the upstream node, access any field via {{.metadata.key}}
builtinVarQuestionDescGenerator: The original question sent by the user (referenced in System Prompt, used to inform the model of context)
upstreamVarScoreDesc: Score of node "{{nodeId}}" (0~1, reviewer nodes only). Add binding below: variable name={{nodeId}}_score, source path=node.{{nodeId}}.score
upstreamVarPassedDesc: Whether node "{{nodeId}}" passed review (true/false). Add binding below: variable name={{nodeId}}_passed, source path=node.{{nodeId}}.passed
upstreamVarFeedbackDesc: Review feedback text from node "{{nodeId}}". Add binding below: variable name={{nodeId}}_feedback, source path=node.{{nodeId}}.feedback
contextVarTimestampDesc: Current execution time, RFC3339 format (auto-injected for processor/reviewer nodes, usable directly; other nodes need binding: context.timestamp)
contextVarUserIdDesc: Current logged-in user's ID. Binding required: context.user_id
contextVarSessionIdDesc: Current conversation session ID. Binding required: context.session_id
contextVarPipelineIdDesc: Current pipeline ID. Binding required: context.pipeline_id
nodeOutputDesc: Output text content of node "{{nodeId}}" (auto-injected, no binding needed)
typeDescTransparentForward: Outbound Forward: Shared node for direct/transparent/jump, use the 'Outbound Policy' toggle to distinguish behavior
typeDescGenerator: Generates initial content (restructures requests to call LLM); for daily outbound, prefer 'Outbound Forward'
typeDescProcessor: Post-processes content: optimization, translation, summarization, etc.
typeDescReviewer: Quality review and scoring of generated results; configurable scoring criteria
typeDescRouter: Routes to different branch nodes based on conditions
typeDescAggregator: Merges results from multiple upstream nodes
typeDescCache: Reads or writes cache; supports exact/semantic matching; configurable read/write storage backends
typeDescTokenUsage: Built-in token usage plugin; records upstream LLM token usage to database
typeDescToolCallInjector: Injects tool call instructions into the pipeline; supports conditional triggers and template variable resolution
warnNoPlugins: No registered node plugins found. Please confirm the backend is started and plugins are registered.
errorLoadPlugins: Failed to load node plugins. Please check the backend service.
infoPluginManager: Plugin manager feature is not yet implemented.
infoAutoDependTokenUsage: Token Usage node has been automatically set to depend on upstream LLM nodes to ensure execution after generation.
warnCannotConvertSoleGenerator: Do not convert the sole generator into a Token Usage node. Please keep the generator node and add a separate usage node.
successNodeUpdated: Node config updated. Please click 'Save' to persist to the server.
